## v0.182.0 MAIL AAYI!: the proactive watcher — Hoola tells her when mail arrives (rules, snooze, quiet hours)
- Owner: "START PHASE 2" (of the Gmail 100% plan). Still NO new Google scope: the watcher reads
  `users.history.list` with a stored historyId watermark (scope gmail.modify already grants it); IMAP/Outlook
  watchers ride a since-watermark listing. No Pub/Sub on a single VPS.
- NEW `mailbox/sync.py`: `sync_tick` (worker.mail_jobs slot, every 60s, round-robin start rotation so at scale no
  mailbox starves; cap 60 accounts/tick) -> per-account `sync_account`: Gmail = profile() watermark + history.list
  (messagesAdded filtered to INBOX, minus SENT/DRAFT/CHAT, 3 pages max); a 404/purged historyId (or any MailError)
  falls back to a plain recent listing — nothing is ever lost. FIRST PASS ON A FRESH MAILBOX IS SILENT
  CALIBRATION (watermark bharo, khabar nahi) — nobody gets a flood of old mail on connecting or deploying;
  switching off -> vip/all also recalibrates (Gmail behaviour: no backlog announce). Watermarks, recent-ids
  (dedupe, last 60), mode and last_error live in the new `MailSyncState` table (tenant+account, auto-migrated).
- Watch modes (per mailbox, `email_accounts watch_mode=` or the Email screen): off (shant) / vip (DEFAULT:
  important mail [Gmail IMPORTANT label or classify needs_reply/bills] + "apne log" = the learned address book
  sent_to>0; OTP/login alerts always announce) / all (sab; bulk mail becomes one grouped digest card instead of
  one each). Mute list (`email_accounts mute=` / clear) silences senders completely.
- NEW `email_rule` tool: her own rules, Santosh-side so they work for Gmail AND Outlook/IMAP. match = from words /
  subject words / has_attachment / bulk / unread; actions = label (Gmail apply_label adds WITHOUT archiving,
  others move to folder), archive, star, mark_read, important (Gmail), mute, notify, forward_to — A FORWARD RULE
  ONLY PREPARES A DRAFT CARD (kind=forward, "attachments nahi hain" note); Santosh NEVER auto-sends or
  auto-replies. Rules run QUIETLY (a rule's work makes no announcement card unless its notify action says so),
  apply to NEW mail only, never delete. pause/resume/delete/test (test = dry run against the newest inbox mail).
  `MailRule` table (tenant-scoped JSON match/actions, hit counter).
- NEW `email_snooze` tool (Gmail parity): snooze = read (mark_seen=False) -> archive -> `MailSnooze` row
  (5 min..30 days); worker snooze_tick wakes due rows: move back to inbox + mark unread + email_snooze card +
  "Snooze khatam" note in her chat. cancel = wake at once. when = ISO local time or hours/days.
- Announcements: `email_new` events (LOCAL kind) carry from/subject/snippet/otp/important/account — OTP digits
  are masked to •••• SERVER-SIDE before any card leaves (regex \b\d{4,8}\b, same discipline as triage).
  push.py maps email_new/email_snooze to FCM titles ("Nayi mail: <from>" / "Snooze khatam"). `email_snooze`
  events + wake notes complete the loop.
- Flutter: `email_new` / `email_snooze` feed cards (chat_screen EmailNewCard: Padho / Jawab do / Archive quick
  actions + snooze chips 1 ghanta / Kal subah — they speak to Santosh in chat; EmailSnoozeCard for wakes),
  state.dart merges both by kind+id; Email screen gains the "Nayi mail ki khabar" watch-mode chips (Shant /
  Zaroori / Sab) + a rules editor (name, from, subject, archive/star/mark-read/label, pause switch, delete) on
  the NEW REST endpoints GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/mail/rules, POST /api/mail/watch, POST /api/mail/mute,
  DELETE /api/mail/snoozes/{id}; api.dart grew mailRules/mailRuleCreate/mailRuleEdit/mailRuleRemove/mailWatch/
  mailMute/mailSnoozeCancel. i18n en table for the new strings.
- Prompts §78 grew the watcher paragraph (watch modes, rules never send, snooze); EMAIL_LABELS for the 2 new
  tools (18 email tools now); manifest description mentions watcher/rules/snooze. GmailBox gained profile(),
  history(page_token), apply_label(); base Box defaults raise clean Hinglish errors on non-Gmail.
- Tests: `tests/test_email_phase2.py` (16) — first-run silent calibration, history tick announces only new mail
  + watermark advance, expired-history fallback heals the watermark, vip gating (stranger shant / VIP + OTP

  run changes nothing, rules fire quietly with hits counter, notify action makes a card, forward rule makes a
  pending draft and never sends, mute rule suppresses, snooze add/wake/cancel + min window, version. Ritual:

## v0.183.0 GMAIL SETTINGS: vacation reply, signature pushed INTO Gmail, aliases, auto-forward (the settings phase)
- Owner: "PHASE 3 -- NOW END TO END" (of the Gmail 100% plan). The only phase that needs a NEW Google scope:
  `gmail.settings.basic` added to GMAIL_SCOPES on the dedicated mail OAuth link AND surfaced in google_check.py
  FEATURES (gmail_settings) — the Google sign-in path already shows every ticked scope. Old mailboxes keep working
  for mail/watcher/rules exactly as before: `MailAccount.scopes` (new auto-migrated column) stores what Google
  actually granted (set at finish_link, refreshed on every token refresh), `settings_scope_ok()` reads it, and any
  settings attempt without it answers with the honest "ek baar Profile > Email se dobara jodiye" — never a silent
  failure, never a doomed API call (the tools check BEFORE building a card).
- NEW `email_vacation` tool: get (live view: on/off, message, subject, window as local-time labels, contacts_only)
  and set — any ON or OFF shows a tier-2 confirm card ("Vacation reply chalu/band karein?") that spells out the
  auto-jawab text, the window ("Abhi se … tak / band karne tak"), the contacts-only note and the truth that Gmail
  answers EVERY incoming mail while it is on. Validation: ON needs a message; end must be after start; start
  defaults to now. PUT /settings/vacation (millis), GET round-trips it back.
- Signature sync: `email_accounts signature_push=true` — the mailbox's Hoola signature is pushed INTO Gmail via
  sendAs.update on the PRIMARY sendAs (POST-card; Gmail's signature field is HTML so text lines are html-escaped
  and joined with <br> — a "<b>FNW</b>" in her signature arrives as literal text, never live HTML). Empty
  signature -> "pehle email_accounts signature=... se set kijiye".
- Aliases + auto-forward read view: `email_accounts send_as=true` returns aliases (primary flag, verification
  status, has_signature) AND the current auto-forwarding with a Hinglish disposition label. Read-only — sending
  FROM an alias stays Phase 4.
- Gmail's own auto-forward: `email_accounts auto_forward='<address>' | 'off'` — ALWAYS behind a tier-2 card
  ("Auto-forward chalu/band karein?"); invalid addresses are refused at card time; switching OFF preserves the
  address Gmail already has (its PUT always carries one); Google refusing the set (unverified forwarding address)
  becomes "pehle Gmail web ke Settings > Forwarding mein verify kijiye". disposition defaults to keep (mail stays
  in the inbox too).
- Bazar: 3 new confirm specs on the mail executor (confirm_vacation / confirm_signature_push /
  confirm_auto_forward), cards computed from the mailbox + args, santosh-mail.json manifest carries them; EMAIL_LABELS
  grew email_vacation (19 email tools now); prompts section 78 grew the settings paragraph (settings changes ALWAYS
  wait for the user's own tap; Gmail answers every mail during vacation — say it plainly).
- NEW GET /api/mail/settings (read-only: vacation + aliases + forwarding + scope_ok) for the Email screen; no
  unguarded settings-write endpoint on purpose — writes happen in chat, behind cards, on the user's tap.
- Tests `tests/test_email_phase3.py` (9): vacation get + card round-trip (nothing changes before the tap, PUT
  after approve, window labels), window/contacts validation + scope-gate (old mailbox: no card, no API call, the
  "dobara jodiye" note everywhere incl. service-level raises), signature push (PATCH on primary, escaping, card
  first), aliases + forwarding read view, auto-forward card on/off + address validation, settings refuse on
  non-Gmail boxes, the consent URL carries the scope + finish_link stores it + the old-token diagnosis,
  google_check FEATURES, the API endpoint, version. Ritual: 0.183.0 (main.py APP_VERSION + pubspec 0.183.0+213 +
  test_v0179 + test_email_phase1/2 pins + console ?v=0.183.0). Deploy: git pull + pm2 restart santosh-core; the
  phone needs no new APK for this (server-only). Next: Phase 4 polish (send-from-alias, colored stars,
  in:snoozed view, Profile "Gmail, poora" help card, manifest finalisation).


## v0.184.0 GMAIL POLISH: saved searches, weekly digest, send-from-alias, snoozed pile, nested + coloured labels (Gmail 100% complete)
- Owner: "START PHASE 4" (final phase of the Gmail 100% plan). No new Google scope — everything rides gmail.modify
  plus the v0.183.0 settings scope where sendAs listing is needed. 4 of 4 phases done: 100% of the official-API
  Gmail surface; the 3 impossible-by-API items stay honestly impossible (hard delete is our own safety rule,
  report-phishing is covered by Cyber check_email; star COLOURS verified not settable through Gmail's API —
  label colours ARE, and are shipped instead).
- Saved searches (`email_rule kind=search`): the rule table gains a `kind` column ("rule" | "search", auto-migrated,
  old rows stay rules). A saved search is a NAMED match she can ask for again ("bank wali mails dikhao"): match =
  from / subject / has_attachment / bulk / unread (works on EVERY mailbox kind, filtered Hoola-side with the same
  matcher rules use) or `query` = a raw Gmail search string ('from:hdfcbank has:attachment') that goes to Gmail
  VERBATIM on the search folder (GmailBox.list skips the folder operator for folder="search"). Running one ONLY
  lists what matches right now — nothing moves, nothing is announced; the watcher never sees them (rules_for and
  rules_list both filter kind). actions: email_rule searches / run rule_id=... / delete works for both kinds;
  paused search refuses to run. GET /api/mail/rules now also returns "searches".
- Weekly digest: `email_accounts daily_summary='weekly 09:30'` (also 'week 09:30') creates the "Weekly inbox
  summary" routine with repeat=weekly (runs on the weekday of the first run) and a wider instruction (last 7 days,
  pending replies, bills due soon, newsletters/bulk count, top senders — never OTPs). '09:00' switches back to the
  daily "Inbox summary" routine, 'off' cancels BOTH titles; switching kinds always replaces (both titles are
  cancelled first). MAX_ROUTINES guard still applies.
- Send-from-alias (coverage #33, the last "send" gap): `email_draft from_alias='hello@newtika.in'` — validated at
  draft time AND again at send time by `service._alias_verified(tenant, box, alias)`: the mailbox must be Gmail,
  the alias must be in its sendAs list AND verified (pending -> "pehle Gmail web ke Settings > Accounts mein
  confirmation click kijiye"); listing aliases rides gmail.settings.basic so a not-yet-reconnected mailbox gets
  the honest v0.183.0 "dobara jodiye" BEFORE any card exists (same gate as vacation). The alias is stored on
  EmailDraft (new nullable `from_alias` column, auto-migrated), shown on the draft card (draft_view.from_alias),
  used as the MIME From: header (mime.build from_addr), and honoured by save_to_gmail pushes too. Sending from the
  mailbox's own address needs nothing new. The Bhejo tap remains the only way it ever leaves.
- Gmail's own snoozed pile (coverage #37): FOLDER_Q gains "snoozed" -> the official `in:snoozed` operator (verified
  against Google's operator docs); `email_check folder='snoozed'` lists it read-only on Gmail; non-Gmail boxes get
  the honest "Snoozed folder Gmail ka apna hai; Hoola ke apne snooze email_snooze action='list' se" (never a
  silent empty list). Hoola's own snoozes (v0.182.0) are unchanged.
- Labels: nesting + colours (the plan's "colored stars / nested labels display"):
  - Nesting: Gmail nests with "/" in the name; `email_label create name='Office/Clients/Acme'` creates each missing
    level in order (_ensure_label_path walks labels_full), so the path really nests in Gmail web/app; `list` now
    returns a `tree` (name/path/children) next to the flat list.
  - Colours: `email_label color name=... color=red|orange|amber|yellow|green|mint|teal|sky|blue|lavender|purple|grey`
    -> labels.update with a (backgroundColor, textColor) pair from a fixed palette Gmail accepts. An unknown colour
    gets the palette list AND the honest note that STAR colours are not possible through Google's API (say it
    plainly — verified: no API surface, unlike labels). Non-Gmail boxes get the clean "Gmail mailbox par" refusal.
- Profile > Email "Gmail, poora" help card: an ExpansionTile at the top of email_screen.dart listing what Hoola now
  covers end to end (read/sort incl. Gmail's snoozed pile, write incl. alias sending, self-organisation incl. rules

- Tests `tests/test_email_phase4.py` (12): saved-search save/run/delete + empty-match refusal + run changes

## v0.185.0 MERA PC BROWSER INTELLIGENCE: Hoola reads her browser like a person (page text, tabs, downloads, verified typing)
- Owner: "NOW LETS WORK ON MERA PC :::: WE WILL MAKE IT VERY POWERFULL THAT HOOLA AI CAN PERFROM ALL OPERATIONS ON
  BROWSER VERY SMOOTHLY. FIRST READ THE MERA PC." Then: "start with Phase 1 + 2 (PC-side browser intelligence + speed)".
  This work is the owner's explicit unfreeze of the Mera PC freeze (exception recorded like v0.180.0; safety rules
  untouched — ask_approval / OTP / no-passwords all unchanged).
- PHASE 1 — PC-side browser intelligence (Santosh Desktop 1.4.0, new `desktop/santosh_desktop/browser.py`, Windows
  UI Automation): the browser (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Firefox) exposes its page as an accessibility tree, so the
  desktop now answers 4 NEW jobs: `page_text` (the page's exact words in order: labels, prices, buttons, errors +
  title + address-bar URL; 240-node walk budget, ~1-3 s, degrades quietly off-Windows), `tabs` (open tabs with
  number / title / which is active via TabItem IsSelected), `switch_tab` (move by title substring or index:
  SelectionItem → Invoke → Click fallback), `downloads` (recent files in her Downloads folder, .crdownload/.part
  flagged STILL DOWNLOADING) and `verify_typed` (after every `type`, the focused field is read back via UIA — ONLY
  {kind, length, matches true/false} travels to the server, never the value, so Locker-filled IDs stay private).
  `open_url` was rewritten: it finds the RUNNING browser (tasklist, cached 30 s), focuses its window, ctrl+l →
  clipboard-paste → enter (a NEW TAB in HER browser — no more default-browser-opens-Edge trap), then waits for the
  page-load signal WITHOUT DevTools: the window title (= active tab title) must change and hold steady 2 polls,
  max 8 s; result carries {in: "Chrome (new tab)", title, loaded}. requirements.txt adds
  `uiautomation>=2.0.18; sys_platform == 'win32'`.
- PHASE 2 — speed on the server (`pc/operator.py` + `pc/hub.py`): 4 NEW operator tools wired to those jobs
  (page_text / tabs / switch_tab / downloads) with Hinglish `_say` lines, hub JOB_TIMEOUT entries (35/30/35/30)
  and old-desktop "Unknown action" → clean upgrade note (same as open_url since v0.166). `open_url`'s result now
  reports "page title now: …" and, when loaded, rides a FREE page_text digest (800 chars, log=False, failures
  ignored) — wrong site / login wall / error is visible in ONE step instead of screenshot-guessing. `type` reads
  the desktop's verify block: mismatch returns "typed, BUT the field does NOT show the sent text (n chars)…
  clear and retype" so dead submits self-heal; old desktops stay plain "typed". switch_tab joins MOVES_SCREEN +
  FOCUS_MOVERS (a tab switch holds same-turn clicks, v0.91.1 rule) with SETTLE_S 0.6; open_url settle 1.2 → 1.0
  (the desktop waits for the page itself now), its timeout 30 → 50 s. BUDGETS: `_WEB_TASK` regex picks browser
  jobs from her words (urls, chrome/browser/online/youtube/form/download/irctc/…) and `_budget()` gives them
  MAX_STEPS_WEB=64 / TASK_MINUTES_WEB=22 (was 40/15 for everything); `Op.steps_max`/`Op.minutes` feed the live
  card, work labels and the loop, so "PC (37/64)" is honest. SYSTEM prompt gained the BROWSER READING section
  (page_text beats pixel guessing, tabs/switch_tab never re-open a site, downloads before "done", retype on
  verify-mismatch) and open_url is described as new-tab-in-her-browser.
- Tests `tests/test_v0185_pc_browser.py` (19): web-task budget pick + start() sets steps_max on the live card,
  tool schema + prompt promises + _say lines, page_text/tabs/switch_tab/downloads end-to-end through the loop
  (FakePC), switch_tab holds blind clicks, downloads finished vs STILL DOWNLOADING, type verify warns on
  mismatch / confirms on match / stays quiet on old desktops, open_url title+digest / old-desktop plain /
  upgrade note for browser tools on a 1.3.x desktop, real `browser.downloads()` flags partials, page_text
  degrades off-Windows, desktop 1.4.0 + APP_VERSION pins. All previous PC suites still green (35 tests).
- Ritual: 0.185.0 (main.py APP_VERSION + pubspec 0.185.0+215 + desktop __init__ 1.4.0); lands on top of the parallel Gmail-polish v0.184.0.. The desktop needs a NEW
  SantoshDesktop.exe (1.4.0) on her PC for page_text/tabs/switch_tab/downloads/verify + the new open_url; the
  server keeps working with 1.3.x desktops (plain open_url, no browser reads, upgrade note when tried).


## v0.185.1 VOICE CALL FIX: the generic 1007 that killed every call (affective dialog now heals process-wide)
- Found LIVE on the VPS the day 0.181–0.185 first actually went live (the deploy had silently re-copied v0.180.0
  since ~v0.181: the VPS checkout sat on branch mcp/santosh-server, so git pull always said "Already up to date"
  while local main sat 7 commits behind; fixed with git fetch + checkout main + reset --hard origin/main). With the
  real code finally running, EVERY voice call died: Gemini refuses enable_affective_dialog with a generic
  "1007 None. Request contains an invalid argument." that never names the field, so v0.181's _affective_refused()
  (matches only "affect"/"enable_affective" in the message) never fired; SETUP_STEPS has no affective rung, so the
  ladder burnt mcp → vocab → langcodes and the call still ended "done: 0 turns" — Hoola picked up and said nothing.
  The error log also showed 15 ack clips in a row "not made: client has been closed" (the dying old process's ack
  thread; clips cache to disk after one good build, so cosmetic — but the batch now builds with ONE shared client).
- Fix (voice.py): the connect-error heal now ALSO fires on a GENERIC setup refusal (setup_refused()) while
  affective is on — drops enable_affective_dialog once, process-wide (_AFFECTIVE remembers), rebuilds the config
  and reconnects inside the same call. The named-field refusal path is unchanged, and with affective already off
  a generic 1007 still climbs the SETUP ladder exactly as before and ends in an honest error event (no heal loop,
  no hang). Net: one refused connect per process, then calls behave like v0.180 (which worked) minus affective.
- Ack clips (voice.py): _build_acks makes ONE genai client for the whole 16-clip batch and hands it to _ack_tts
  (new optional client= param; old 3-arg callers unaffected). If the batch client cannot be made, each clip falls
  back to a fresh one exactly as before. 16 client handshakes per batch → 1.
- Tests test_v01851_voice_heal.py (4): the exact VPS shape (generic 1007 on the first connect → second config has
  no affective, the call completes, the process remembers), affective-already-off + generic 1007 still climbs the
  ladder and ends honestly (no heal loop), the ack batch builds every clip with exactly ONE client, _ack_tts without
  a shared client still works. Also repaired two v0.185.0-stale pins the sweep had missed (test_v0178_realtime: the
  PC card steps_max + work line now assert the run's REAL budget — a browser-worded task runs 64, not MAX_STEPS 40)
  and test_human_voice's fake _ack_tts grew the client= param. Full ring green: voice core, v0.181, human voice,
  v0.185 PC browser, v0.179 search, email phase1–4, realtime, voicestyle (132 tests).
- Ritual: 0.185.1 (main.py APP_VERSION + pubspec 0.185.1+216 + the six conscious-bump pins 0.185.0→0.185.1 +
  console ?v=0.185.1). Desktop untouched 1.4.0 — no exe rebuild, server-only deploy. Instant VPS mitigation without
  this deploy: VOICE_AFFECTIVE=false in ~/apps/santosh-core/.env + pm2 restart santosh (remove the line after
  deploying 0.185.1 to get affective back).


## v0.180.0 REAL TIME: the phone sees every task as it happens (Mera PC + all her own tasks)
- Owner: "HOOLA AI MUST SEE THE TASK IN REAL TIME NOT DELAYED. CURRENTLY EVERY TASK IS COMPLETED THEN AFTER FEW SEC
  IT GIVES REPLY. SOME TASKS TAKE LONG, SOME NEVER REPLIED. FIX THIS PERFECTLY... FOR MERA PC AS WELL AS FOR ALL OWN
  TASKS." Four root causes found and fixed (PC freeze lifted by the owner for exactly this; desktop untouched 1.3.1).
- Root cause 1 — the phone never streamed: the server has streamed replies since v0.161 (reply_start / delta /
  reply_end, live-only) but the phone's SSE client never asked for them (no `live=1`) and had no delta handling —
  replies appeared only when the model finished. Now: `Api.events(live: true)` (old servers just ignore it), live
  events (id 0) pass through, `state.dart` builds a growing 'stream' bubble per turn (reply_start -> deltas ->
  reply_end), the final message (same `turn` tag) replaces it — the chat answers word by word like a person.
  A reply caught mid-writing on reload continues from GET /live. Empty bubble on reply_end is removed cleanly.
- Root cause 2 — the PC card was not alive in the chat: `_event()` only fired at start / status changes. Now the
  card gets a `browser` event on EVERY step (Step n/40 + a thin progress bar + what she is doing right now) and the
  Soch state while the vision call runs. `op.action` became `_say()` — short human Hinglish lines ("Chrome khol raha
  hoon", "likh raha hoon (27 akshar)", "'ctrl+s' daba raha hoon", "aapki manzoori ka intezaar…") — privacy-safe by
  design: never the typed text, never OTP/ID values, URLs only as host. The work line counts steps too ("PC (3/40):
  ..."). The card and the full live screen both show 'Soch raha hoon…' while the vision call runs.
- Root cause 3 — a turn could die silently: code before run_turn's inner guard (persona, memory, place, history,
  saving the user message) could crash -> BackgroundTask exception swallowed -> NO reply and typing dots for ever.
  Now `run_turn` is a never-silent wrapper around `_run_turn`: whatever crashes, the chat still gets a reply
  (friendly error, saved) and `typing off` is always published (CancelledError still passes through).
- Root cause 4 — typing dots hung after a dead turn: the SSE stream now re-sends `typing on` every ~60 s while the
  chat's turn really holds the lock (`santosh.turn_running`), and the phone clears the dots 75 s after the last
  refresh — a crashed turn's dots go away by themselves instead of spinning for ever.
- Also repaired 8 stale tests the dev's own 0.174–0.177 work had broken (fake `_think` signatures now accept
  `tools/live`; robust_chat pins streaming off; export/healthz version pins use APP_VERSION; FastAPI app version
  back on the APP_VERSION constant). Full suite: zero regressions — every failing file fails identically at HEAD
  (playwright/network sandbox limits) and everything else passes.
- Tests `test_v0178_realtime.py` (6): word-by-word streaming to a live stream (and live-only, old streams never see
  deltas), no invented deltas for a non-streaming brain, crashed turn still replies + typing off, turn_running
  mirrors the chat lock, PC card narrates every step live (step order, Soch state, privacy: typed text never shown),
  `_say` narration privacy/wording. Ritual: 0.180.0 (main.py APP_VERSION + FastAPI version + pubspec
  0.180.0+210 + console cache busts + test_v0179's APP_VERSION pin); phone needs the new APK for streaming;
  server-only deploy also works (old APK unaffected). Re-versioned after the dev's 0.178 chat-premium and
  0.179 console-search landed mid-work (rebased on top of both; their new tests also use the APP_VERSION pin).

## v0.177.1 PC operator yaad: Hoola remembers what she did on this PC ("all infinite tasks" memory)
- Owner: "WHEN DESKTOP WORK IS GOING BY HOOLA AI IT MUST REMEMBER... I TELL HOOLA TO OPEN WHATSAPP ON CHROME IT OPENS,
  BUT LATER 'SEND MSG TO THIS PERSON ON WHATSAPP' HOOLA FORGOT WHATSAPP IS ALREADY OPEN AND OPENS EDGE" — every
  pc_do used to start from zero: fresh messages, no idea what it opened 10 minutes ago. Done ON the owner's explicit
  ask (the Mera PC freeze names this one exception). Version re-aligned after rebase onto the dev's 0.174–0.177.
- `app/pc/memory.py` (new): per-tenant task memory in the DB (`pc_memory` table, one row per person, JSON entries).
  `remember()` is called in the operator's `finally` for EVERY finished run (done / partial / failed / even cancelled
  with where it stopped): task text, WHAT was opened (`Op.mem` — open_app Chrome / open_url https://web.whatsapp.com /
  window close 'X' / focus_window — real tool args, not the model's phrasing), result status, her-language answer, and
  the LAST ACTIVE WINDOW (so "WhatsApp - Google Chrome" survives even after the operator forgets the picture).
  `recall()` drops entries older than `pc_memory_hours` (24) and caps at `pc_memory_runs` (8); only the newest 6 go
  into a prompt. `forget()` on device revoke (unpair = memory of that PC goes with it).
- The next run's system prompt gets a YAAD block ("your own recent finished work on THIS PC (newest first)... build on
  it, never redo it") right after the ID LOCKER. And SYSTEM itself grew the reuse-first discipline (works even with an
  empty YAAD, because the first screenshot already lists open windows): look before opening — if the app/site is
  ALREADY open (window or browser tab), focus it and continue THERE, never a second copy; browser continuity — work
  started in Chrome stays in Chrome (open_url opens her DEFAULT browser: if the site is already open in Chrome, do not
  open_url again, it can open Edge — focus Chrome, ctrl+l, type, enter).
- Privacy note: memory stores only task text + tool names/args (open_app/open_url/window/focus/screenshot-monitor) +
  the final answer + last window title — never typed text, screenshots, OTPs or ID numbers.
- Tests `tests/test_v0173_pc_memory.py` (6): the WhatsApp scenario end to end (task 1 opens WhatsApp Web in Chrome;
  task 2's system prompt carries the YAAD with the task, open_app/open_url and the WhatsApp window; WhatsApp Web is
  never open_url-ed again), reuse-first rules always in the prompt, first-ever task has no fake memories, cap=3 and
  TTL expiry (a 2-hour-old entry under a 1-hour TTL never reaches the model), unpair forgets, a cancelled run still
  records where it stopped. Also fixed the stale export version pin in `test_v171_transcript.py` (asserted 0.173.0 —
  broke at the dev's own v0.174–0.177 HEADs; now follows APP_VERSION 0.177.1).
- Ritual: version 0.177.1 (main.py APP_VERSION + FastAPI version + pubspec 0.177.1+207 + test_routines assert).
  Desktop untouched: still 1.3.1, no exe rebuild needed (server-side memory only). Deploy unchanged: git pull +
  cp server/app + pm2 restart.

## v0.185.4 "PC PAR KAAM RUK GAYA" ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED (PC tasks died a few steps in, every time)

- Owner report (26 Oct): every Mera PC task starts and then Hoola says "PC par kaam ruk gaya" — work drops in
  between instead of completing systematically. Evidence pulled LIVE from the VPS via the vps-ops workflow
  (`job=errors`): `ERROR santosh.pcop: pc operator failed` twice that afternoon (13:40:50 + 13:42:43), both
  ending `anthropic.BadRequestError: 400 - invalid_request_error: 'messages.N.content.M.tool_result: all
  content must be type `text` if `is_error` is true'` at operator.py:754 (the per-step vision call).
- THE BUG (operator.py `_run`): at the end of every action round the loop attaches the fresh screenshot INSIDE
  the LAST tool_result of the round (`results[-1] = {**results[-1], "content": [prev_text, *shot]}`). When that
  result was an error (`is_error: true` — a REFUSED shortcut / idvault refusal, the v0.91.1 held_blind guard, a
  `_do` exception), the screenshot's image block rode inside an is_error result. The API rejects the WHOLE next
  request (that exact 400), `_run`'s outer handler marks the task failed, `_report` says "Aapke PC par kaam ruk
  gaya". Error results are routine in real PC tasks, so nearly every non-trivial task died a few steps in —
  the "drops work in between" the owner saw.
- FIX, three layers (operator.py): (1) the producer — the flag is dropped before the screenshot rides in (the
  error text itself stays in plain sight); (2) `_sanitize()` — the invariant "is_error ⇒ text-only" enforced
  over the WHOLE history before every model call, so a task started on an older build heals too (screenshots
  inside error results become a one-line note); (3) `_think_retry()` — one 400 (sanitize + same call again),
  transient connection/timeout/429/5xx/529 failures (2 more tries, short backoff) no longer kill a 20-minute
  task; plus `_shot_retry()` — a single busy screen capture (her one WebSocket, she may be using the PC)
  retries once instead of failing the task.
- TESTS: NEW tests/test_v01854_pc_is_error.py (7): the exact bug shape (error result + round-end screenshot →
  flag stripped, image rides without is_error, REFUSED text intact, invariant holds, task reaches done); a pure
  text is_error result KEEPS its flag; _sanitize flattens image-in-error and leaves legal results untouched;
  the EXACT VPS 400 now heals in place (3 creates, done); one connection error heals (2 creates, done); one

## v0.185.3 THE AFFECTIVE HEAL MOVES TO WHERE THE REFUSAL REALLY ARRIVES (the connected-but-silent call)

- THE REAL SHAPE (live VPS pm2 log, 26 Oct ~11:49, both calls "done: 0 turns"): the google-genai SDK's
  connect() returns BEFORE setupComplete, so Gemini's generic "1007 Request contains an invalid argument"
  does NOT raise at connect - it arrives mid-stream as "voice stream ended: ConnectionClosedError(Close
  (code=1007, reason='Request contains an invalid argument.')...)". The v0.185.1 heal sat only on the
  connect-error path, so in production it never fired; the SETUP ladder climbed rung by rung
  (without mcp -> mcp,vocab -> +langcodes -> +compression) with enable_affective_dialog STILL ON in every
  rebuilt config, and every rung was refused. voicecheck kept saying "healthy" because its _attempt()
  catches the refusal wherever it arrives and drops affective - the instrument was right, the call loop
  was not. The old v0.185.1 test faked the refusal AT connect (raise before yield) - green tests, broken
  production path.
- FIX (voice.py call loop): in the setup_refused() handling - AFTER the mid-call-client_content branch and
  the stale-handle branch, BEFORE the ladder climb - the same process-wide affective drop now runs:
  _AFFECTIVE["ok"] = False, log, retry the SAME setup once. With affective already off (or VOICE_AFFECTIVE
  =false in .env) the ladder climbs exactly as before - no loop, no hang. Connect-time heal unchanged.
- TESTS: NEW tests/test_v01853_voice_stream_heal.py (2) - the EXACT VPS shape (connect ok, receive() raises
  the real websockets ConnectionClosedError(Close(1007))): heal fires in place, 2 connects, ladder untouched,
  the healed session's turn plays out to turn_done; and with affective off the stream-close still climbs the
  ladder to the honest error event. Version 0.185.3 (pubspec 0.185.3+218, console ?v=0.185.3, conscious pins
  0.185.2->0.185.3 in test_v0179/email_phase1-4/test_v0185); desktop untouched 1.4.0 (server-only deploy).
- Owner-side instant mitigation (no deploy): VOICE_AFFECTIVE=false in ~/apps/santosh-core/.env - the config
  then matches exactly what voicecheck proved works (works_at=0).

## v0.187.0 REALTIME: the first words fast, and every job's result in Hoola's own words (owner: "AI doesn't monitor tasks end to end; delayed response after 30s more")
- Owner's two complaints, root-caused by a three-agent deep analysis of the turn pipeline: (1) EVERY model call re-sent all
  384 tool specs = 568 KB (~142 K tokens) plus a 120 KB system prompt, uncached on the production brain -> 15-60 s TTFT per
  call, xN steps, before any word; the words existed only in the FINAL call. (2) All ~32 task families DID post a canned
  kaamwatch line on completion, but it carried no result, was silenced while her turn ran (`in_turn`/young), and the chat
  brain never followed up on its own - "jab result aaye to batana" was a promise nothing kept (only the voice call's
  late-result loop worked).
- FIX 1 - schema diet (agent/tools.py): every tool NAME, type, enum, required field and nested structure untouched; prose
  shrinks with graduated caps - ordinary tool descriptions to 140 chars (first sentences), safety-word tools (confirm /
  approval / consent / otp / password / tier-2 / bhejo / manzoori / payment / money in the description) to 700 so their
  rules survive, property descriptions to 72. 568 KB -> 383 KB per call (~33%, ~24 K tokens x every one of the up-to-24
  calls). _RAW_SPECS + DIET_STATS kept for tests; diet applied in-place at import (TOOLS[:] =), so dispatch / TOOL_LABELS /
  handlers are untouched. Old APKs benefit with zero changes.
- FIX 2 - the 5-second ack (agent/santosh.py): a turn that says nothing for `agent_ack_after_s` (config, default 5) sends
  "Ek second, dekh raha hoon…" (6 variants, gendered) as an EPHEMERAL message - events.publish(ephemeral=True) fans out to
  the chat's open streams only: no Event row, no chat-list touch, NO FCM push, no kaamwatch; a reload never shows it, the
  real reply replaces it. One per turn (_ACKED), owner chats only (voice calls have their own ack clips), every condition
  re-checked after the wait: turn over / stopped / words already streaming (livereply.partial) / an assistant Message saved
  in the last seconds -> no ack.
- FIX 3 - say-lines (agent/say.py + livereply.feed_say + STREAM kind "say"): after EVERY tool step, one TRUE line about the
  result ("12 mails mile", "Video taiyar — drive.google.com") streams while the next model call thinks. Rule-based from the
  tool result (count/total/items length, url -> host-only, query strings stripped, ok/status) - no model call (that would be
  the delay we are killing), never a guess: no fact -> no line; errors stay the step chip's job. The phone renders it as a
  small italic whisper with a breathing dot above the stream bubble (state.dart _sayItem + chat_screen 'say' case +
  _SayDot), cleared on reply_end / final message; old APKs ignore the kind silently.
- FIX 4 - kaam_followup (new server/app/kaam_followup.py): a done/failed watched job now gets ONE message in Hoola's own
  words with the actual result - a tiny one-shot call (pakka._ask: cheap brain, NO tools, ~400 tokens) over a digest built
  from kaamwatch's shaped job (label/title/state/detail + NEW link capture from url/link/preview_url/file_url/share_url/
  download_url/path/file, query-stripped, 300 cap). kaamwatch._update enqueues on every done/failed (deduped per key+state,
  10 min window) INSTEAD of posting the dry line; worker slot followup_jobs (every ~10 s, after kaam_jobs) sends pending
  ones; a report whose chat has a turn running is POSTPONED (tries++, at 5 the canned line goes out anyway - never lose the
  news); _recent_said skips when her turn's own reply already named the job (last 4 assistant messages, 5 min); model empty
  or failed -> the honest canned ✅/❌ line (fallback counter); sent via events.notify (Message + SSE + FCM) + the same
  quiet voice.inject note as every kaamwatch line. New table kaam_followups (auto-created); KAAM_FOLLOWUP env off-switch;
  prompts.py teaches the promise is now real ("poora hote hi bata dungi" - and the result message IS the truth, no
  re-checking; never invent a manual follow-up mechanism).
- Tests: NEW tests/test_v0186_realtime.py (15): diet keeps all 384 names/order/uniqueness + enums/required/properties +
  shrinks >25% + safety prose survives as a clean prefix; ack publishes only when silent-held (ephemeral kw asserted), skips
  when words already out or turn over, ephemeral publish stores no Event and pushes nothing; say-line rules true-or-silent +
  feed_say accumulates (dup no re-send, last-3 window); followup: done job -> her voice + link stored + NO dry line +
  voice note, model failure -> ✅ fallback, failed -> ❌, running turn postpones (tries++) then sends after, turn's own reply
  dedupes to skipped, enqueue dedupes. Sweeps green: email x5 + v0185_pc_browser + v0179_search 101, bazar + cards +
  routines 31, v0178_realtime 6, livework + robust_chat + basics 15, NEW 15 (168 total in-sandbox; the google.genai voice
  suites can't import in this sandbox - pre-existing). Version 0.186.0 (pubspec 0.186.0+219, console ?v=0.186.0, conscious
  pins 0.185.3->0.186.0 in test_v0179/email_phase1-4/test_v0185); desktop untouched (server + phone deploy).

## v0.192.0 Design Router - one CR design per user topic (owner: "NOW PDF GENERATED IN ONLY ONE DESIGN -- WE WANT IT TO BE GENERATED IN 1 CR DESIGN BASED ON USER TOPIC")
The complaint was exact: v0.189's six named styles changed ONLY the hue - cover architecture, fonts, table style were one skeleton shared by every PDF. The fix is a topic ROUTER (server/app/docstudio/designs.py, NEW): `detect_topic(title, text)` scores keywords (English + Hinglish + Devanagari; title hit = 3, body hit = 1 capped at 3 per keyword, Devanagari hit = 4; ties by rule order; zero = general) across 12 families (finance, technology, education, health, legal, marketing, people, agriculture, government, travel, festive, general) and `resolve_design` returns a FULL design: hue anchor + deterministic per-title jitter (+/-10 deg - same title always gets the same design), one of SIX cover architectures painted in pdfgen._cover (band = deep top band, title reversed in white - finance/government; rail = full-height side rail - technology/people; plate = bottom colour plate carrying the meta - education/health; sunrise = light corner block + deep bottom band - festive/marketing/travel; minimal = hairlines + accent square, zero fills - legal; classic = exact v0.189 geometry - general/agriculture), a TOPIC FONT PAIRING resolved at runtime from a defensively-registered pool (pdfgen._FONT_DIRS: Tinos, Carlito, Liberation Sans/Serif, DejaVu Sans/Serif, FreeSans, FreeSerif floor - a corrupt or missing TTF drops THAT family and the chain falls through, never the build; this sandbox's broken Tinos-Regular.ttf proved it live), grid or clean tables (clean keeps every iron rule: Paragraph cells, widths <= available, centred, repeatRows, M-tier header fill + L-tier zebra - it only trades the vertical grid for horizontal accent rules), H1 rule weight and Page-N footer per family. 12 families x hue jitter x 6 covers x pairings x 2 table styles = a crore of distinct looks, every colour still minted by tokens.Palette's tier caps. make_pdf returns `design {topic, cover, fonts, table, detected}`; doc_studio's style enum grew to 17 (explicit topic styles welcome) and the result carries the design + a note ("Design matched to the topic: Finance (band cover, ...)"); prompts teach `style auto` = topic-matched. BACKWARD COMPAT: professional/boardroom/warm/elegant/forest keep BYTE-IDENTICAL v0.189 output (classic cover, FreeSerif, grid, STYLES hue) and auto with no topic signal lands on general = the exact v0.189 auto behaviour. Tests: tests/test_v0192_pdf_designs.py (14) - detection EN+Hinglish+Devanagari+fallback, title-beats-body, determinism, distinct families get distinct designs, legacy byte-compat x5 with palette equality, explicit topic style, design in the result, all six covers render + QA pass with the title on page 1, pairings resolve to registered fonts and never Helvetica, fallback when families are absent, clean-table iron rules, Devanagari through any design, tool schema + delivery carry the design. ## v0.191.0 Excel at scale + full coverage (owner: "complex Excel and lakh number of column and all Excel coverage work 100% - MAKE PLAN THEN DEPLOYMENT")
The honest physics first: the XLSX format itself caps one sheet at 16,384 columns (XFD) and 1,048,576 rows - no tool on Earth can put a lakh columns in ONE sheet, so the studio delivers lakh-scale honestly: up to 16,384 cols in one sheet, and an AUTO-SPLIT beyond. server/app/docstudio/xlsxgen.py: MAX_COLS 120 -> 16,384 (Excel's own limit), MAX_ROWS 5,000 -> 100,000; a sheet wider than 16,384 auto-splits into 'Name-P1'..'Name-PN' parts (the first column repeats as the row key on every part) plus an auto-built 'Index' sheet listing every part's column range - a 20,000-col request lands as Mega-P1 (16,384 cols) + Mega-P2 + Index in ONE workbook; THE v0.189 SILENT-TRUNCATION LIE IS DEAD - row/sheet clipping is now a named QA issue ("100,006 rows maangi thi, 100,000 likhe"), sheets[].cols reports WRITTEN cols (not the input length), and the deep preview reads ws.max_column so the model always sees the truth; BIG SHEETS switch strategy (>100K cells, >256 cols or >10K rows): zebra becomes ONE conditional-formatting rule (MOD(ROW(),2)=0) instead of per-cell fills, row heights default, body fonts default - 20K rows x 8 cols builds in seconds, small sheets keep the exact v0.189 per-cell styling (18 old tests untouched and green); auto-fit widths measured on the first 64 cols only, wider sheets get sheet_format.defaultColWidth=11; FULL COVERAGE per-sheet extras (a sheet value may be a dict {rows, conditional_formatting, validation, merges, defined_names}): conditional formatting (color_scale / data_bar / cell_is / expression), data validation (list / number / date - a YYYY-MM-DD formula1 becomes DATE(y,m,d) because Excel wants a serial), merges, workbook defined names (a name that looks like a cell ref gets the N_ prefix) - every range rebased onto the designed grid (+3r+1c) exactly like formulas; the classic formula set is WELCOME and taught in prompts (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX+MATCH, SUMIF(S), COUNTIF(S), AVERAGEIF(S), SUMPRODUCT, TEXT, DATE, SUBTOTAL, IF/AND/OR/IFS/SWITCH) while the dynamic-array refusal stays (XLOOKUP/FILTER/UNIQUE/SORT/SORTBY/XMATCH/SEQUENCE/LET/LAMBDA/RANDARRAY, refused with the sheet+cell named) and formulas over 8,192 chars warn (Excel's own limit); charts 3 kinds -> 9: bar, column, line, pie PLUS scatter (markers only, no connecting line), area, doughnut (holeSize 58), radar (marker) and COMBO bar+line on a secondary axis (line.y_axis.axId=200 + crosses=max, the line survives a re-open inside the BarChart frame's _charts); caps 6 per sheet / 30 per book (was 3/12); pivot tables stay an HONEST NO - no Python library creates real pivots (openpyxl only preserves existing ones), the prompts teach the SUMIFS-matrix summary sheet instead; doc_studio's schema sheets/charts descriptions carry the new surface (16,384, split, dict extras, 9 chart kinds) and a wide build's tool result says "20,000 cols Excel ki ek-sheet limit (16,384) se bade the - 2 parts + Index bane". Tests: NEW server/tests/test_v0191_xlsx_scale.py (20) - limits match Excel's own, 16K-col sheet builds whole (max_column 16,385), lakh auto-split with exact part boundaries + Index ranges, row clipping LOUD, too-many-sheets LOUD, big-mode CF zebra + typed values survive + build < 90s, small-sheet v0.189 per-cell zebra intact, classic functions welcome, XLOOKUP refused with the cell named, 8192-char warn, all 9 chart kinds re-open with the right class, combo carries its LineChart sub-chart, chart caps, all 4 CF types with rebased ranges (B2:B4 -> C5:C7), list+decimal validations, merges + defined names rebased, bad extras are warnings not crashes, deep preview reports written cols + cf/dv/names, 16K + split preview views, tool schema carries the new surface, doc_studio delivers a wide sheet with the split note. Backward compat: v0.189 docstudio suite 18/18 green untouched. ## v0.190.0 HARNESS-1 (re-versioned on rebase: the dev's Document Studio had taken 0.189.0 first - both kept): the dsh / Claude Code study → three latency killers + one monitoring hole (owner: "READ deepseek-harness, research how Claude harness works, make plan for HOOLA AI, then deployment")

The owner's order: read `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`, research how Claude Code's harness works, make the plan for
HOOLA AI, then deploy. Deep study done (dsh monorepo: session log / ctx.jobs dual-lane completion / ctx.goals /
compaction 0.8-0.16 / tool-result pruner 8192→4096+1024 / spill / bounded parallel pool 10 / KV-cache discipline;
Claude Code: 8-step loop, read-parallel write-serial batching, ~13K-token auto-compact, cached vs uncached prompt
sections, microcompaction). The plan (phased) is in the chat + worklog; PHASE 1 ships here:

- Pruner (NEW server/app/agent/prune.py): old steps' tool results leave the REQUEST (head 2800 + one-line marker +
  tail 500 above PRUNE_OLD_RESULT_CHARS=3500; envs PRUNE_*); the newest step stays whole (the model is about to use
  it); her messages and the memory/goal blocks (text lists) are never touched; PURE projection - the stored history
  and the in-memory dicts `_save` holds are untouched (pruned blocks are copies), idempotent, nothing is lost (the
  DB keeps full results; the next turn reloads them fresh). Wired at BOTH `_think` call sites. Why: every tool
  result is capped 6 KB at birth but stayed 6 KB in the history forever, and the history rides into every one of up
  to 24 (goal 80) model calls - a research turn carried ~90 KB of stale page text into every later call; the
  production brain has no prompt cache, so that was pure TTFT tax (dsh prunes exactly like this; Claude Code
  microcompacts).
- Parallel read-only look-ups (santosh.py): the per-tool body is extracted into `_one(b)` (every path RETURNS one

## v0.190.1 P0 HOTFIX (found LIVE on the VPS 2026-10-26: load 147, healthz silent, santosh flapping, ~2500 pm2 restarts)

The owner said "P0 hotfix + v0.190.0 implementation" - v0.190.0 was committed and CI-green but NEVER deployed
(last VPS ops run predated the push), and the status job exposed the real P0: the box was in a load spiral.

- ROOT CAUSE 1 - the kaam_followups table NEVER existed on the live DB. The model had only LAZY imports
  (worker.tick and kaamwatch.enqueue import it inside the function), so init_db's create_all() never saw it;
  every tick since v0.187 went live died 'no such table: kaam_followups' (13 tracebacks per 150 log lines) and
  enqueue's INSERT died silently in its try/except - finished jobs NEVER reported, the owner's 'jab result aaye
  to batana' was a broken promise in production even though 297 tests were green (tests import the module
  before init_db; production imports it after - the classic order trap). FIX: db.init_db now registers
  kaam_followup explicitly, AND kaam_followup.ensure_table() self-heals on the first tick/enqueue (checkfirst
  create) - old DBs repair themselves at the first touch after deploy, no manual SQL.
- ROOT CAUSE 2 - the TV catalog refresh ran on the first loop of EVERY process start: fetch every iptv-org list
  + parse + probe every stream with 24 workers (thousands of httpx GETs, each one an INFO line to the error log)
  - a restart-y server re-did this at every boot, the flood was still running minutes into every diagnosis.
  FIX: tv.catalog._needs_refresh() - the daemon skips while channels.json is under 23h old; only genuinely
  stale data (or a first boot) refreshes.
- ROOT CAUSE 3 - /api/browser/{sid}/live|frame were polled ~90 rps during the spiral (704 completions in 8 s);
  every poll a fresh thread + handler. FIX: a 1 s per-(kind, tenant, session) memo (TTL 1 s, 512 entries, lock-
  guarded OrderedDict) in front of both endpoints - the phone polls every 4 s and never notices; a flood now
  costs one real call per second per session.
- PLUS httpx/httpcore INFO logging silenced (main._quiet_http_logs, wired in lifespan) - every probe line left
  the error log; warnings and above still speak; inbound access log (uvicorn.access) untouched.
- Tests: NEW tests/test_v0190_hotfix.py (9): tick survives the dropped table and self-heals; enqueue queues on
  an old DB and the report flows; init_db creates the table on restart; ensure_table idempotent; fresh list
  skips / 25h-old refreshes / missing refreshes; daemon reentry guard; memo TTL + per-session isolation +
  eviction cap; httpx quiet. Sweeps green: hotfix(9) + realtime + harness + pc_browser 51; api + routines +
  bazar + cards 33; email x5 + search + goal + basics 116; livework + robust_chat + pc_is_error + console 20;
  gcal + gdrive + drive + employee + avatar + appcheck 64 = 284 passed, zero failures (google.genai voice
  suites unimportable in this sandbox - pre-existing). Version 0.190.1 (pubspec 0.190.1+225, APP_VERSION,
  console ?v=0.190.1 x9, conscious pins 0.190.0->0.190.1 in test_v0179/email_phase1-4/test_v0185/test_v0187/
  test_v0189). Deploy carries both v0.190.0 HARNESS-1 (never live) and this hotfix in one restart; desktop
  untouched 1.4.0, old APKs keep working (all four fixes are server-side).
## v0.198.0 SAMAJHDAR CARD (re-versioned TWICE on rebase: Excel-at-scale took 0.191.0, Design Router took 0.196.0 - all works kept) (owner: "BIGGEST ISSUE: RESULT AND APPROVAL CARD" -> choices: CAPTCHA ek confirm ke baad apne aap type; non-money orders voice haan se approve; "NOT ONLY HAAN, ANY KARDO, APPROVE HAI ETC")

The approval/result card was dumb: an irrelevant HAAN card fired on almost every PC step (2-4 per pizza task),
and in voice-to-voice saying "haan" did NOTHING - the card waited for a tap, the op stalled 600s and died (RC-A
over-triggering ask_approval, RC-B tap-only voice dead-end, from the v0.191 RCA in the worklog). Five fixes:

- approval_words.py (NEW) - approval ki boli EK jagah: pure approvals (haan/haanji/haan karo/kar do/kardo/yes/
  approve/approve hai/confirm/theek hai/sahi hai/manzoor/ok/pakka/bhej do/aage badho/go ahead/+ Devanagari हाँ कर दो/
  मंज़ूर है), rejection ALWAYS wins (nahi/mat karo/rehne do/cancel/band karo; "mat" ke baad ke approval shabd ulte -
  is_pure_rejection unhe nikaal kar dekhta hai), approve_lead ("haan, address yeh raha" = yes + extra, 7 tokens max;
  "pizza order karo" = naya kaam, kabhi lead nahi), money_risk (pay/upi/bank/card/cvv/otp/password/pin/₹/rs) - bol
  ya likh se money approval KABHI nahi. Tokenizer Devanagari-aware (Python \w candrabindu/nukta kaat deta hai).
- TAPGATE (pc/operator.py, RC-A ka ilaaj) - ask_approval par classify: (1) CAPTCHA: pehli baar card; op.captcha_ok
  set hone par is task ki har aage CAPTCHA auto-type ("ek confirm ke baad apne aap type"); (2) popup/cookie/banner/
  notification ALWAYS auto (checked first - "cookie banner hata doon" is not a remove-risk); (3) money/order/bhejna/
  delete/install/settings = card; (4) benign steps (cart/search/form bhar/tab/download/login/continue) auto-approve
  with a note that teaches the model not to ask again; unclear = card (safe default). SYSTEM prompt narrowed:
  "SUBMITS a form" -> "the FINAL form that creates something real" + an explicit kabhi-mat-maango list. Result:
  pizza flow makes ZERO meaningless cards.
- VOICE APPROVAL PATH (voice.py, RC-B ka ilaaj) - Call._approval_listen, the _otp_listen pattern: on every input
  transcription piece a pure yes approves INSTANTLY (the stalled job moves while she talks); at turn end a pure
  "nahi" rejects and an approve_lead ("haan par cheese burst bhi...") approves + Gemini gets a note with her extra
  words; money words in her utterance = the honest "yeh card se hoga" note, never an approval. bazar.service.
  voice_approve/voice_reject + voice_pending (pending pcop/browser, non-money, <=15 min young) -> decide(notify_ok=
  False) so ONE line is spoken (no double result message). CHAT too: run_turn's owner block resolves a pure typed
  "haan karo" before the brain (never for "pizza order karo").
- RESULT INTELLIGENCE (kaamwatch.py) - KINDS.browser (aapka PC + Hoola browser dono kind='browser' bolte hain):
  needs_confirm -> waiting = the call hears "aapki baari - card par haan, ya bas bol kar 'haan karo'"; voice_only
  (no chat line - the card IS the story); no_start_say (running steps say nothing, the live card is already there);
  shape() now reads session_id as a job id (pc/browser events never had 'id' - the browser kind was invisible to
  kaamwatch before this). done/failed keep the v0.187 one-result-message followup.
- CHANNEL SPLIT (Flutter + console) - card_of.voice_ok on every non-money pcop/browser approval; _BazarCard shows
  "Bol kar bhi ho jayega - 'haan karo' ya 'approve' kahiye." (chat AND the live call tray - both render feedCard);

## v0.195.0 HOOLA KA APNA PC — Phase 1 of the per-user coworker environment (owner: "HOOLA OWN PC / ENVIRONMENT / CPU, RAM ETC FOR EVERY USER WHERE HOOLA COWORKER CAN WORK, INSTALL SOFTWARE ETC SAME LIKE OPEN AI DOTS AND LIKE MUSE OR LIKE GROK BOT — FIRST DEEP RESEARCH AND THEN A PERFECT PLAN" → "START PHASE 1")

Deep research first (20+ sources): OpenAI Dots (persistent agents, each with its own cloud computer + browser), Meta Muse (per-user Secure VM + the Sentinel egress watcher + human-approval dialogs straight to the user, never through the model), Grok Bot (role-based bots, each with its own cloud computer, live screen watch + takeover), Manus (per-user VM, Cloud Computer), Anthropic's computer-use harness (Ubuntu container + Xvfb + xdotool + the computer/bash/editor tools, "you can install Ubuntu applications with your bash tool"), CUA/Operator, E2B/Daytona/Fly/Hetzner infra costs. The one pattern they all share: per-user persistent cloud computer + browser + logged-in sessions + watchable screen + human takeover + egress policy. Hoola already owned ~80% of it (pc/operator.py vision loop + bridge + voice dispatch + wake lane) — the missing piece was a computer that belongs to Hoola.

Shipped in Phase 1 (all on the existing VPS, zero new infra cost):
- `desktop-linux/agent.py` + Dockerfile + start.sh + compose: the Linux cloud PC that belongs to Hoola. Speaks the EXACT Windows Santosh Desktop bridge protocol, so hub pairing, jobs, the vision loop, page_text/tabs/switch_tab/downloads and the live phone card all work unchanged. Xvfb 1280x800 + openbox + xdotool + scrot (screen/mouse/keyboard), Chromium over CDP (exact page_text/tabs/open_url, lazy launch), files over /data, pairing by the normal 6-digit code (docker exec → /data/pair_code), state on the hoola-pc-data volume (identity + chrome profile with logged-in sessions + Downloads + installed.log). Image ~150 MB RAM idle, <1 GB busy.
- `pc/hub.py`: a tenant can have SEVERAL PCs — info.kind preserved, hub.call(kind=) / _pick / is_online(kind) / has_kind; no kind = legacy last-connected (her-PC-only setups never notice). JOB_TIMEOUT += install 500 / run 200.
- `pc/operator.py`: Op.kind="hoola_pc" — every job rides hub.call(kind=...); HOOLA_TOOLS adds install (apt/pip, names only) + run (one shell command ≤180s); HOOLA_PC_ADDENDUM teaches the VM ("this computer belongs to you — installs and shell need no approval; anything LEAVING the VM still needs ask_approval; passwords/OTPs same rules"); her-PC wording byte-identical; HOOLA_PC_OFFLINE is its own clear error.
- `agent/pc_tools.py` hoola_pc_do (family "pc" → admit.py admits it on pc/computer/laptop words), `agent/where.py` place "hoolapc" (aapke/tumhare/apne/hoola ke + computer wins over the bare-noun PC match; steer browse_web/open_on_phone/computer_operator → hoola_pc_do, pc_do refused with the pointer; work-stickiness kept), prompts.py teaches the third computer, voice.py carries it (8s _wait lane).
- `vps-ops.yml`: pc_deploy (build + run the container), pc_pair (6-digit code in the lines field, validated on the runner), pc_logs.

Tests: NEW server/tests/test_v0193_hoola_pc.py (18) — hub kind routing + legacy fallback, where.py hoolapc words (Hinglish + Hindi + negation + regressions), steer/note/worked, the REAL operator loop on the Hoola PC (install flows end to end, the model sees the addendum + install/run tools, her-PC loop never does, kind rides every hub call), HOOLA_PC_OFFLINE vs PC_OFFLINE, install/run shapes incl. shell-metachar refusal, _say/_report/_inject wording, registry + FAMILY_OF + voice wiring. Regression sweeps: pc bridge + v0185 pc browser + v01854 is_error 30, harness x2 + search + realtime 45, bazar + email 1-2 53, email 3-5 + long goal 51 — 197 passed, zero failures.

## v0.192.0 HARNESS-2 (re-versioned on rebase: the dev's Excel-at-scale had taken 0.191.0 first - both kept) (Phase 2 of the harness study - owner: "START STEP 2 PERFECTLY AND DEPLOY"): step-admitted tool subsets + job-completion WAKE turns + the durable accepted-message inbox

Phase 1 (v0.190.0) documented three gaps "fixable now"; this ship closes all three, exactly as planned (dsh:
step-admitted subsets + deferred families + tool search, completionDelivery wakeup + maxConsecutiveWakes, durable
session state; Claude Code: small stable tool sets, background-task notifications, crash-safe turn ownership):

- Step-admitted tool subsets (NEW server/app/agent/admit.py): a turn shows the model ONLY the tool families her
  words actually need, on top of a small always-on CORE (kaam_status, kaam_plan, bazar, web, gyaan, procedure,
  google_status, make/memory, life, maps, file_read, id_locker, ai_kharcha, phone_health + the unmapped base
  campaign specs + tool_search). Routing = family auto-keys (family tag + tool-name words, stopwords stripped)
  + a hand-written Hinglish/Hindi/English map (mail→email, calendar→gcal, spreadsheet→sheets, "bhej/send"→email
  + drive, photo→photos, video/reel→video+reel, order/amazon→shop, courier→courier, gst/payroll/vakil→their
  desks...). Measured on the merged tree: a casual chat turn = 45 specs, a mail turn = 79 specs (~45 KB) instead
  of 391 specs (~381 KB) - every one of the up-to-24 (goal 80) calls pays only its share, the direct TTFT win on
  the cache-less production brain. THE SET IS COMPUTED ONCE PER TURN and stays byte-stable across all its steps
  (the Anthropic cache holds); `tool_search` (tiny always-offered spec + handler in admit.py) admits a family for
  the REST of the turn - one deliberate cache re-write, then the model uses the new tools. Safety: a valve falls
  back to the FULL registry when the router over-matches (> tool_admit_cap=220); admission only changes what the
  model SEES - dispatch(), employee.gate, the confirm-card rules, Rokiye, where.steer all run exactly as before;
  missed families never break a job (dispatch still knows every handler; prompts teach "never call a job
  impossible: tool_search first"); routine / staff / customer actors keep the FULL set (their gates already
  restrict them); wake turns route on the job digest itself so the follow-up sees the tools the result talks
  about. Config agent_tool_admission (default True).
- Job-completion WAKE turns (kaam_followup): when a finished/failed/stopped job's chat is IDLE (no turn holds the
  lock), the REAL brain is woken instead of only the v0.187 one-shot line - run_turn(actor="wake", save_user=
  False) with the job's own public status line + "batao apni awaaz mein; adhura lage to tools se haalat check
  karke sahi jaankari do". Hoola may verify with tools (kaam_status, email_bulk_status, ...) and reports through
  the normal message path (SSE + FCM push + the quiet note into her live call). Bounded like dsh: budget of
  agent_wake_max_consecutive=3 wakes per chat per agent_wake_window_min=10 minutes, her next message resets it
  (santosh calls wake_reset), the window ages out; ANY failure (model down, empty text, exception) falls back to
  the v0.187 one-shot line - the news is NEVER lost. A wake turn never streams (live=None + _NO_STREAM guard: a
  live call on this chat owns its own reply stream), never chains a goal continuation, and rides the routine
  usage lane (never the employee budget).
- Durable accepted-message inbox (NEW server/app/turn_inbox.py + worker slot inbox_jobs): POST /messages now
  persists the accepted message (turn_inbox table) BEFORE the 202 and the turn runs wrapped
  (accepted→running→done/failed) - a pm2 restart or crashed worker no longer silently eats her message. The
  worker sweep (every ~15 s) re-runs dead turns ONCE (tries<2), idempotently: skip when a real in_history
  assistant reply already exists after acceptance; accepted-but-never-started past turn_inbox_stale_s=120 = the
  task died before it ran; running-with-FREE-lock for 5 min = the process died mid-turn (a LIVE turn always
  holds the conversation lock - the tool-steps-keep-running case can never false-positive); the re-run passes
  save_user=False when her message row survived, so history never doubles; done rows cleaned after a day.
  Config agent_turn_inbox (default True).
- Tests: NEW tests/test_v0191_harness2.py (15): core-subset routing (45-spec chat turn, everyday tools in, the
  big unrelated families out), word routing (mail/video/spreadsheet) incl. the short-key guard ('id' never
  matches inside 'video', 'app' not inside 'apple'), per-turn byte-stability, tool_search opens a family for the
  rest of the turn (through the real dispatch), the valve, admission-off, the diet surviving admission (every
  admitted spec IS the registry spec); the wake turn fires for an idle chat with actor='wake' + the digest +
  voice note + row sent + no dry notify, the budget (3 → fallback line, wake_reset restores, window ages out,
  running-turn postpones then wakes when free), wake-off; the inbox (accept persists, run_owned wraps, a dead
  accepted turn re-runs once with save_user=True and never twice, an already-answered row is skipped, live
  turns are left alone, a mid-turn crash re-runs with save_user=False). Fallout fixes: the v0.187 one-shot tests
  + v0.189 stopped-job test + routines API test pin the fallback path / patch the inbox-wrapped runner (they
  pin the OLD path, wake-off via auto-restoring monkeypatch). Sweeps green: ring1 (email x5 + cards + bazar +
  basics + realtime v0.187 + goal v0.186 + pc v0.185 + search v0.179 + harness v0.189 + NEW + docstudio) = 199;
  ring2 (routines + livework + robust_chat + human_voice x2 + voicestyle + voice_heal + pc_is_error + realtime
  v0.178) = 56; ring3 (api + console_build + gcal + gdrive + drive + employee + employee_inbox + avatar +

## v0.193.0 HARNESS-3: the AGENT TEAM + the event-sourced session log (Phase 3 of the harness study, made ADVANCED - owner: "Phase 3 (subagents, event-sourced session log) --- MAKE IT MORE ADVANCE AS USER TELL HIM DEPLOY SEVERAL AGAENTS THEN IT MUST DO --- LEVEL OF OPUS 5.5")

Phase 3 of the deepseek-harness + Claude Code plan (dsh subagents 8-active/depth-1 + the event-sourced session log;
Claude Code's parallel Task tool), built ON TOP of everything HARNESS-1/2 shipped - and made more aggressive than
the study: she says "kai agents lagao" and Hoola actually deploys several agents that work at the same time.

- The AGENT TEAM (NEW server/app/agent/team.py): the brain splits a job into INDEPENDENT parts and calls
  deploy_agents with one agent per part (name + task + optional tool families). Every sub-agent runs its own
  mini-loop - own model context, own admitted tool subset (the same admission machinery: CORE + the turn's
  families + the requested ones, tool_search works inside an agent too), own throwaway history (never saved to
  the chat), 8 steps, 240 s wall clock, 1500 max tokens - and all agents of a crew run TOGETHER
  (asyncio.gather; wall time = the slowest agent, not the sum). Their deliverables come back in ONE tool result
  and the main brain merges them into her answer in her own words ("their facts are the truth, add nothing").
  DEPTH 1 (dsh): a sub-agent's tool list never contains deploy_agents / agent_status. CAPS: 4 agents per deploy,
  8 per turn (ctx.team_used), max 160 admitted specs per agent, one broken/timed-out agent never kills the crew.
  TRUST UNCHANGED: a sub-agent runs as the delegating brain's own actor through the same dispatch() - every
  confirm card, employee gate, OTP rule and Rokiye applies exactly as before (Rokiye stops an inline crew with
  the turn via santosh._stopped; agents check it every step). Wake turns never deploy crews.
- Background crews ("team laga di, kaam hone pe khud bataungi"): mode="background" persists the crew
  (agent_teams table, registered in init_db on day one + ensure_table() self-heal - the v0.190.1 lesson), the
  turn answers AT ONCE, and a worker slot (team_jobs, ~20 s) runs it. Completion rides the EXISTING machinery
  with zero new reporting code: bus "agent_team" events -> kaamwatch shape (label "Agent team", a KINDS entry; the
  team id rides in the watched title so the turn's own "team laga di" reply can never mask the result through
  the dup check) -> kaam_followup -> the v0.192 WAKE TURN with the real brain when the chat is idle (the wake
  digest carries the crew's deliverables; agent_status action=check re-reads the full text). Live progress:
  "2/3 agents kaam poore" stage lines (kaamwatch's own 5-min throttle applies) + per-agent step cards on the
  phone. agent_status action=stop is the crew's Rokiye (the runner checks the row between steps and bails;
  the stopped news reports like any stopped job). Crash recovery: a "running" row not held by this process and
  stale > 10 min (agents heartbeat the row every step) re-runs ONCE (tries cap 2). Per-tenant cap: 2 crews.
- The event-sourced session log (NEW server/app/agent/eventlog.py, the dsh foundation): every turn writes
  turn_started / turn_finished / turn_failed under a per-turn id; every tool call and result writes
  tool_call / tool_result with duration and ok (a ContextVar carries turn_id + actor, so sub-agents log under
  team:<name> inside the same task); crews write agent_spawned / agent_finished / team_synthesized; the wake
  lane and the inbox write wake / inbox. Writes are BEST-EFFORT and never break a turn (self-mute 60 s after a
  DB failure), per-chat rows capped at 4000, daily retention sweep (eventlog_jobs, 14 days). The BRAIN reads its

## v0.204.0 FOCUSED WORD-LEVEL MEMORY — call-drop continuity + verbatim words on both paths (owner: "WHY HOOLA NOT ABLE TO KEEP THE THING INTACT ONCE TELL BY USER --- FORGOT THE ENTIRE JUST PREVIOUS WORK. ALSO FORGOT WORD AND EVERYTHING. ALSO IF CALL DROPS WITH USER FORGOT ALL CURRENT GOING WORK. IT MUST BE LIKE HUMAN. FOCUSED WORD LEVEL MEMORY WITH BOTH VOICE TO VOICE AND CHAT") (re-versioned 0.200.0->0.204.0 on rebase: the dev's parallel v0.200 Mera-PC-personal + v0.201 Mera-PC-final + v0.202 Awaaz-2 feeling engine + v0.203 PC-to-PC bridge took the numbers first - all kept, REBASE PROTOCOL respected)
THE RCA (exact): (a) a fresh voice session was briefed by `yaad.voice_block`, whose recent exchanges were 360-char ONE-LINERS (`one_line(ex, 360)`) — the exact words of the recent work never reached a new call; (b) `greeting()` told a fresh session "do not bring up anything from before" — a network drop past `voice_resume_grace_s` (25 s) ended the call, and the next call opened like a COLD START ("Arre, good morning!") with the interrupted work compressed to a gist line; (c) in chat, exchanges older than the newest ~4 were compressed (`compress()`: steps → ≤14 gist lines, values clipped 40–60 chars, `gist()`), and past the 40–49 exchange window only the ≤1600-char summary survived — "jo maine bola tha" had no words left to point at. Facts were paraphrased by a model; `LAST_OUTCOME` lived only in process memory.
THE FIX — FOCUSED WORD-LEVEL MEMORY, both paths, zero new latency (pure SQL, no model, no extra model calls): (1) **`yaad.focus_block()`** — her newest messages VERBATIM (`focus_user_words`=6, 600 chars each) with `_when` timestamps, read from `Messages.display` so chat turns AND `[Voice call]` turns share ONE word-level memory and a pm2 restart forgets nothing; a call that died mid-air within `voice_continuation_min` (60 min) rides with its last words; whole block capped at `focus_max_chars`=4000 ("focused" = small and exact, never a dump); the chat path excludes her CURRENT message (it is the message being answered); volatile, rides the current message only — the cached prompt prefix stays byte-identical (the v0.108 rule). Wired into `turn_block` (chat) and LEADS `voice_block` (voice). (2) **`yaad.FocusNote`** (`focus_notes` table; `ensure_focus_table()` self-heal with the `_table_ready` flag — the v0.190.1 lesson; yaad is already imported in init_db day-one) + **`voice.py _save_drop_note()`**: at grace expiry the dying call saves her last complete words + the half-said sentence (`user_buf`, OTP-masked like finish_turn) as a `call_drop` note; `note_call_drop` prunes to 20 notes/chat and 7 days; an abandoned dial with zero turns writes NOTHING. (3) **CONTINUATION, not cold start**: the next NEW call consumes the note (`take_call_drop`, read-ONCE) and `greeting(continuation=...)` seeds the fresh Gemini session with "YE KOI NAYA CALL NAHI HAI - pichli call kat gayi thi, wahi baat chal rahi thi - ek chhoti line bolo ('Haan, line aa gayi - wahi kaam pe chalte hain') aur USI kaam se aage badho; fresh greeting/introduction bilkul nahi"; until consumed, `focus_block` repeats the note to the brain. (4) The resume-within-grace path and `_reseed` (same-call verbatim replay) are unchanged and keep working; the dev's v0.202 Awaaz-2 feeling engine (voiceaffect.py, DELIVERY_END, ack generation tags) rides untouched beside it.
Tests: NEW test_v0204_focus.py (15) — verbatim words in focus_block (chat + `[Voice call]` turns), exclude-current, turn_block/voice_block wiring, drop-note write→recent→consume-once, aged-note window, grace-expiry note with partial words + OTP mask + timer wiring, abandoned-dial silence, continuation vs fresh greeting, caps, ensure_focus_table idempotent, version pin. Version 0.204.0 (pubspec 0.204.0+238, console ?v=0.204.0 x9, conscious pins →0.204.0 in 16 suites + the sessions cache-stamp set). Server-only — old APKs keep working; desktop untouched; Mera PC freeze respected.

## v0.208.1 MEM-CURE — the voice-to-voice drop root cause, fixed in-process (owner: "OK I WILL INCRSE INFRA" after the RCA)
The RCA (vps-ops mem job): long tasks ran in the same process as live calls; RSS climbed ~100 MB/min
(2.4 GB @29min → 5.03 GB @57min) to eat ALL 8 GB + a 100%-full 4 GB swap; the box force-killed the
process every 10-40 min (14x in 5h, all mid-WebSocket: "Shutting down / Waiting for connections" with
no "Finished server process") — every kill dropped every live call instantly, and in-memory call state
made resume impossible. THREE fixes in-process (infra RAM 8→16 GB still worth it, but the leak is the
code's to stop): (1) events.py stream queues BOUNDED — Q_MAX 400, drop-oldest keeps the newest state
(SSE replays missed events from the DB backlog, so nothing is lost), plus `sweep()`: a queue whose
consumer died without unsubscribe used to receive EVERY later publish forever (the structural leak) —
now pruned at ≥800 missed publishes or a closed event loop; (2) NEW memjanitor.py — `arena_cap(2)`
(mallopt M_ARENA_MAX at boot, before thread churn: the RCA saw a 1.5 GB single heap arena + dozens of
64 MB arenas across 37-44 threads — Python freed, glibc kept) + `malloc_trim(0)` every 5 min (returns
free arena tops to the OS after big transient blocks: screenshots, base64, JSON) + one honest RSS/swap
log line per cycle (`hoola.mem` logger) so the next RCA reads the curve from pm2 logs; (3) GRACEFUL
SHUTDOWN — voice.py `SHUTDOWN` event + `chain_signals()` (our note chains uvicorn's own SIGINT/SIGTERM
handler — installed AFTER uvicorn's capture_signals, original preserved and called) + `shutdown_watchdog`
(tells every live call "Server update ho raha hai — call yahin rukti hai, thodi der mein dobara bulaao"
and closes the phone side with close code 1001, so "Waiting for connections" finishes in milliseconds);
vps-ops deploy/rollback/ack_refresh pass `pm2 restart santosh --kill-timeout 12000` (default 1600 ms
was the SIGKILL inside the wait). Tests: NEW test_v0208_mem.py (queue bound + drop-oldest, sweep prunes
dead/closed-loop queues and spares live ones, _push never raises, arena_cap/trim/rss honest on any
platform, signal chain installs + watchdog goodbye-to-calls + clean return on signalless shutdown,
kill-timeout pins in all three vps-ops restart sites, version pin).
## v0.208.0 AWAAZ-3 — TurnMeter prosody sharpening (Phase C's remainder; owner: "start Phase C remainder" after GOOD on Phase B KAAN KAAPI — the voiceaffect docstring promise "TurnMeter prosody joins later as a sharpening rule, never as the only signal" is now kept)
The v0.202 feeling engine reads WHAT she says; the same TurnMeter that has measured her pauses/pitch/level
since v0.119 now also answers HOW she says it — mid-turn, before he replies. Her words still pick the state
(prosody NEVER fires alone); her voice THIS turn, measured against HER OWN baseline (the voicestyle profile
facts — pitch/spread/level medians of her own calls, now carried to the call in `for_call` facts; a phone mic
lies, her normal doesn't), sharpens it three ways: (1) **VETO** — glad words said in a voice clearly BELOW
her normal (−2 semitones or more, or −4 dB quieter, or flattened to ≤2 st while her normal spread is ≥5 st)
send NO note (sarcasm ya thakaan — a celebration voice over flat words is exactly the uncanny note the
precision rule forbids), and a veto moves NO debounce clock — more words and more voice can still speak;
(2) **CONFIRM** — low words in a dropped/quieter voice (−1 st or −3 dB) count `affect_confirmed`: the
heavy-news note is twice as safe; tense is NEVER vetoed (a raised voice IS the agreement); (3) **PAUSE
RIDER** — two-plus measured ≥600 ms mid-turn pauses (she is thinking while talking) attach "uske rukne par
usse jaldi mat kaato; apne jawab ke items bhi ek ek saans le ke bolo" to whatever note goes out — the ear
test's list-rush failure (scenarios 1+2), grounded in her own measured pauses. Infrastructure:
`TurnMeter._snapshot()` + new `peek()` — the same numbers as `take()`, read MID-TURN without consuming the
turn (`take()` stays the end-of-turn learning call); `config.voice_prosody` kill switch (off = the exact
v0.202 words-only engine); stats `affect_vetoed` / `affect_confirmed` / `affect_pauses_rider` join
`affect_notes` in the scorecard and the end-of-call log line. Tests: NEW test_v0208_prosody.py (21) — peek
non-destructive + same shape as take, prosody-never-alone, thin/absent baseline → words_lead, glad veto ×3
(down / quiet / flat) + glad stands + a naturally-flat speaker passes, low confirmed ×2 + untouched without
agreement, tense never vetoed, absurd baseline ignored, rider needs two real pauses + content pins, wiring:
veto sends nothing and moves no clock / confirm+rider / no rider on neutral words / kill switch returns to
v0.202, `for_call` carries her baseline facts, scorecard counters, version pin. Server-only — old APKs keep
working; desktop untouched 1.4.0; Mera PC freeze respected. Version 0.208.0 (pubspec 0.208.0+242, console
?v=0.208.0 x9, conscious pins →0.208.0 in 20 suites + the sessions cache-stamp set).

## v0.211.0 SEMANTIC BROWSER — browser ops by REF, not pixels (owner: "WHY HOOLA AI IN BOTH MERA PC AND OWN PC, NOT ABLE TO PERFORM BROWSER OPERATION SMOOTHLY AND PERFECTLY --- FIND THE ROOT CAUSE")

THE ROOT CAUSE (proved in code): both PCs ran browser steps as computer-use-by-pixels — the operator loop is
"screenshot -> vision model picks ONE action -> PC does it -> repeat" (server/app/pc/operator.py line 5); every
click was an X,Y GUESS on a lossy 1280px JPEG (quality 72 Hoola PC / 80 desktop), with no DOM knowledge, no
wait-for-element, no hit feedback (the model only learned from the NEXT screenshot one full turn later), and one
action per turn — so each micro-step cost a screenshot capture + upload + vision round trip ("Slow (a few seconds
per step)" was in the tool description itself), a 6-field form took 10-15 turns, and browser tasks died at step 40
before _budget widened them. The v0.86 "960px live frames vs 1280px model view, every click off" bug was the same
disease. CDP/UIA were used only for READING (page_text) — never for ACTING. Chrome codecs (v1.2.0) fixed WHAT
loads; pixels were why the WORK was clumsy.

THE FIX — one shared action contract, two native engines, refs instead of coordinates:
- page_elements: the page's real buttons/links/fields as numbered refs (Hoola PC: ONE CDP Runtime.evaluate DOM
  walk in desktop-linux/agent.py v1.3.0; her Windows PC: the existing UIA accessibility tree in
  desktop/santosh_desktop/browser.py v1.5.0, INTERACTIVE control types).
- page_click / page_type / page_select BY REF: Linux = el.scrollIntoView + el.click(), typing via execCommand
  insertText with the native-setter input/change-event fallback (React-safe), select matches option text and lists
  options on a miss; Windows = UIA Invoke/Toggle/ExpandCollapse/SelectionItem patterns with a control-centre click
  fallback, ValuePattern.SetValue with clipboard-paste fallback. The OS/browser resolves the element — a click
  CANNOT miss on layout shift, scroll or DPI.
- page_fill_form: a WHOLE form in ONE step (entries [{ref,text},...], max 20) — a 6-field form = 1 round trip.
- wait_for: poll the page for a text (max 20s) instead of blind waits.
- SERVER (operator.py): 6 new TOOLS, _do dispatch (idvault REF protection rides page_type like type), _say
  narration lines, _desktop_says upgrade hint extended to the new names (old desktop -> the clean "update the exe"
  line, model falls back to pixels), SYSTEM "WEB PAGES - SEMANTIC FIRST" + HOOLA_PC_ADDENDUM "SEMANTIC MODE IS
  NATIVE HERE". Privacy pins kept: a field's value NEVER returns to the server — only length + matches, both engines.
- desktop/santosh_desktop/control.py: _paste body hoisted into module-level paste_text (shared with browser.page_type).
- vps-ops pc_chrome_selftest proves the chain LIVE on the container: example.com -> page_elements -> page_click the
  more-information link -> iana.org loads.
